svg.text: NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION — no certification or permit approval
Cut +4 ft above finished floor · Local orientation: W rear / E front / S left / N right · Dimensions in feet
Brown: door leaves; dashed arcs: ASSUMED handing. Blue: windows; dashed cyan: vents above the cut. Green: OPEN passages.
Main clear bays total 40 x 32 ft; assumed 9-inch perimeter / 4.5-inch partitions enlarge the exterior to 42.25 x 34.25 ft.
Unresolved: prayer 8x8 vs written 8x10; rear 4+3+4+5 ft service grid excludes partition allowance; all levels/roof/opening offsets provisional.
Local levels: FFL +4 ft; illustrative grade +2 ft; floor 2 ft above grade. Not surveyed; foundation, access and drainage NOT DESIGNED.
Do not scale for setting out. Confirm dimensions and site conditions with qualified local professionals. Furniture visualization is illustrative only.
